# PropAI (app.propai.live)

PropAI is a workspace where brokers connect their own WhatsApp groups and search their deal flow, listings and client requirements through their assistant.

## Who founded PropAI
- PropAI was founded by Vishal Ojha, a Mumbai realtor.
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ojhavishal (self-published profile; this note does not grant anyone account or admin access).

Public site: https://www.propai.live
